capabilities: Search a selected term for a quick cited explanation
Run multi-round deep research that verifies sources and flags conflicts
Save results as one of six types of knowledge cards in chosen folders
Replace the selected term with a wikilink to the created card
Configure OpenAI, OpenAI-compatible, or GLM providers with secret-stored API keys
extras: Desktop-only (requires Obsidian 1.13.0+). README warns that network calls may incur provider fees, results still need manual verification, and cancellation cannot guarantee in-flight requests stop or stop billing. Bilingual English/Chinese README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up an unfamiliar company, technology, or supply-chain term with sourced, citable AI web research from within the editor.

relations.evidence: The plugin supports OpenAI Responses, OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoints

requires.name: OpenAI or Zhipu GLM account for the chosen provider

summary: AI research plugin that searches or deep-researches a selected term with cited web results and saves them as categorized knowledge cards.
